programs.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programs.desc: Andrew explores the charismatic city of Cork, Ireland, where fertile land and an expansive coastline make it a food lovers' haven  locals line up for traditional favorites and artisanal delicacies like Irish stew and drisheen.

programs.title: Chopped: A Chopped Halloween
programs.desc: Halloween-themed ingredients including real blood and fake eyeballs are featured in the first round  the competitors get dead serious about their Halloween entrées.

programs.title: Last Call Food Brawl: Memphis: Ribs and Nachos
programs.desc: Adam Gertler features four of the best early morning cooks in Memphis, who will square off against each other in an epic battle  the challenge is insane nachos and Memphis BBQ.

programs.title: Unique Sweets
programs.desc: From an ice cream shop to a pop-up bake sale, we found the best hangouts in Austin, Texas, to satisfy the sweet tooth.
